answer_1.quote: We study three generative tasks ... page description generation, section summarization, and contextual image captioning ...
answer_1.outputs: generated page descriptions, section summary sentences, and image captions

answer_2.quote: For quantitative results, we report BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, CIDEr ... BLEURT, CLIP-Score and RefCLIP-Score ...

answer_4.quote: We performed a small scale pilot to collect human annotations for the section summarization task ... 94% of the time the majority vote out of five was yes.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked whether the first sentence of a section provides an adequate summary of the whole section.
